title: Rewinding the retained word
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x,y$ be Boolean words, let $c_0$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and let $p$ be an input-head position. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |y|$, the clean wrapper started in the administrative configuration with retained word $y$, control state $4$, input-head position $p$, and capture-head position $j-1$ reaches after exactly $j+1$ steps the administrative configuration with the same retained word and input-head position, control state $5$, and capture-head position zero.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$c_0$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
replaced:
For every $j \le |y|$: from the administrative configuration of the clean wrapper
with retained word $y$ and capture head just left of cell $j$, exactly $j + 1$
steps return the capture head to zero without erasing $y$, advancing control to
the final administrative state.
